any: Didn't see you there. I was just sitting.
grumpy: Can't I sit on my own bed?
What are you looking at?
nervous: I wasn't doing anything, honest.
You scared me. I was only sitting.
chatty: Oh, hey! Just sitting. You know how it is.

any: Huh. The last one in here left something behind.
Well, what have we got here?
chatty: The last tenant left me something. Nice of them.
grumpy: Great. Somebody else's mess to deal with.
nervous: This isn't mine. This really isn't mine.
cheerful: Somebody left me a present! How thoughtful.

any: Is the floor moving, or is it me?
I love you lot. I mean it.
chatty: You know what your problem is? Nobody listens. I listen.
grumpy: Don't look at me like that. I'm fine.
What are you staring at, huh?
cheerful: Best day I've had in here, honestly.
quiet: I'm going to sit down now.
nervous: My face feels funny.
Is it hot in here? It's hot in here.

any: Never seen that before in my life.
grumpy: That was there when I got here.
Great. Now you've got something to write up.
nervous: I don't know how that got there, I swear.
Please don't write me up for that.
chatty: Funny story about that, actually. It's not mine.

grumpy: You going to make it back up, too?
Find anything? No? Didn't think so.
nervous: I told you I don't have anything.
Is that it? Am I in trouble?
cheerful: Nothing under there but crumbs. Could've told you.

grumpy: Of course you found it.
Fine. Take it.
nervous: I was going to hand it in, honest.
It came in the post. I didn't ask for it.
chatty: Okay, okay, you got me. Fair's fair.

any: Can I take my hands off the wall now?
grumpy: Every time. Every single time.
Enjoy that, did you?
nervous: I haven't done anything, I promise.
Why is it always me?
cheerful: Clean as a whistle. Told you.

any: Pick on someone else for once.
chatty: Come on, {other} wouldn't hide a sandwich.
grumpy: Leave {other} be. Bunch of bullies.
Search me next, why don't you.
cheerful: {other}'s the nicest one in here, come on.
nervous: {other} hasn't done anything. Honest.

any: Anything come in the post for me?
Is there a letter for me? I heard the ding.
chatty: {staff}! Anything for me today? I'm expecting a letter.
Mail call yet? Please say yes.
nervous: Did anything come for me? Just checking.
Is that letter for me, {staff}?
grumpy: If there's mail for me, I'd like it before it's old news.
cheerful: Is it mail day? I love mail day!

any: They're doing fine. That's a weight off.
Best letter I've had in ages.
chatty: Listen to this, everyone back home is doing great. Great!
grumpy: Huh. Good news, for once.
nervous: Oh, thank goodness. They're all right.
cheerful: Look at this! Everything's fine back home!

any: My kid drew me a picture. Look at that.
That's me, apparently. Green hair and all.
I'm putting this up on the wall.
chatty: Look! That's our house, that's me, and that's a dog we don't have.
grumpy: Don't say anything. It's a good drawing.
cheerful: A drawing! Best thing anyone's ever sent me.
nervous: They still remember me. That's good.

any: Sounds like nothing's changed out there.
Well, that's something to think about.
chatty: My cousin got married! To who? No idea. Nobody tells me anything.
grumpy: Weather's bad and prices are up. Thanks for that.
cheerful: Nice to hear what's going on out there.

any: That's not good. That's really not good.
grumpy: Great. Just great.
Should've stayed in bed.
nervous: No, no, no. This can't be right.
chatty: I don't really want to talk right now.
quiet: Leave me alone for a bit.
cheerful: It'll be okay. It has to be.

any: This has been opened. Who's been reading my mail?
grumpy: Read my mail, did you? Hope you enjoyed it.
You people have no shame.
nervous: Somebody opened it. What did they take?
chatty: Hey, this was open! Is that even allowed?

grumpy: Can't you read? That's not my name.
chatty: Ooh, someone's got mail! Not me, though.
nervous: I shouldn't take that. It's not mine.
cheerful: Not mine, but I hope it's good news for them.

kid:
